source_text: Ostendit Dominus lignum; missum in aquas dulces fecit. Lignum — crux Christi. Littera amara sine ligno; cum cruce dulcis evangelii sapor.
pass_a_gloss: Showed Lord wood; thrown into waters sweet it-made. Wood — cross of-Christ. Letter bitter without wood; with cross sweet of-gospel savor.
pass_b_english: The Lord showed a [[wood; cast into the waters it made them sweet >> Bible:Exodus 15:25]]. The wood is Christ’s cross. Without it the letter is bitter; with the cross the gospel’s savor is sweet.
